solarArrays.name: Standard Silicon (Si) Photovoltaic Array
solarArrays.explain: Flight-proven silicon solar cells offering dependable power at minimal production cost, though lower efficiency requires larger surface area.
solarArrays.basis: NASA Glenn Research Center PV Database, approximate, game-balanced

solarArrays.name: Triple-Junction GaAs Solar Array
solarArrays.explain: High-efficiency Gallium Arsenide multi-junction cells tuned to distinct solar wavelengths. Delivers superior watts per square meter with slower degradation.
solarArrays.basis: Spectrolab XTJ Prime Solar Cell Data Sheet, approximate, game-balanced

batteries.name: Standard Spaceflight Lithium-Ion Battery
batteries.explain: Flight-certified lithium-ion energy storage cells calibrated for 30,000 shallow eclipse cycles in Low Earth Orbit.
batteries.basis: Saft Space VES 16 Li-ion Specification, approximate, game-balanced

batteries.name: Advanced Silicon-Anode Li-Ion Battery
batteries.explain: Next-generation energy-dense battery cells delivering high capacity at low mass for volume-constrained and long-life spacecraft.
batteries.basis: NASA Battery Workshop Technical Reports, approximate, game-balanced

propulsions.name: Cold Gas GN2 Thruster Pack
propulsions.explain: Non-toxic pressurized gaseous nitrogen thruster providing precise impulse bits for detumbling and small station-keeping maneuvers.
propulsions.basis: Moog Cold Gas Propulsion System Guide, approximate, game-balanced

propulsions.name: Hydrazine Monopropellant Subsystem
propulsions.explain: Catalytic hydrazine thrusters providing dependable moderate thrust for orbital insertion, phasing, and deorbit disposal maneuvers.
propulsions.basis: Aerojet Rocketdyne MR-106 Reaction Control Engine, approximate, game-balanced

propulsions.name: Bi-Propellant MMH/NTO Apogee Engine
propulsions.explain: Hypergolic liquid bi-propellant propulsion delivering high specific impulse for large delta-V maneuvers and planetary transfer insertion.
propulsions.basis: Aerojet Rocketdyne R-4D-15 Hi-PAT 445N Engine, approximate, game-balanced

propulsions.name: Xenon Hall-Effect Electric Thruster
propulsions.explain: Electrostatic ion acceleration achieving exceptional specific impulse at the cost of high electrical power demand and low acceleration.
propulsions.basis: Aerojet Rocketdyne XR-5 Hall Thruster / NASA GRC, approximate, game-balanced

propulsions.name: Deep-Throttle Bipropellant Descent Engine
propulsions.explain: Pintle-injector throttleable engine (10-100%) delivering controllable braking thrust for precision soft touchdowns on airless bodies.
propulsions.basis: Apollo LM Descent Propulsion System (DPS) / Chandrayaan-3 800N cluster, approximate, game-balanced

propulsions.name: High-Thrust Pulsed Landing Cluster
propulsions.explain: Fixed-thrust solid/bipropellant rocket motor cluster providing maximum deceleration thrust with rapid pulsing for terminal descent.
propulsions.basis: Surveyor Retrorocket / Chang'e Descent Cluster, approximate, game-balanced

propulsions.name: Mars Terminal Retro-Rocket Pack
propulsions.explain: High-thrust hydrazine monopropellant pulsed retro-rocket pack engineered for terminal deceleration through thin Martian atmosphere.
propulsions.basis: Phoenix / InSight / Mars 2020 Sky Crane descent stage, approximate, game-balanced

flightComputers.name: High-Performance COTS Processor
flightComputers.explain: Commercial off-the-shelf multi-core computing platform providing massive processing throughput with modest radiation shielding.
flightComputers.basis: Space Micro ProtonX-Box COTS Onboard Computer, approximate, game-balanced

flightComputers.name: Radiation-Tolerant Fault-Tolerant Computer
flightComputers.explain: Triple-modular-redundant processor with error-correcting memory built for long-duration Low Earth Orbit and polar sun-synchronous flights.
flightComputers.basis: Cobham Gaisler GR740 Quad-Core Fault-Tolerant LEON4, approximate, game-balanced

flightComputers.name: RAD750 Radiation-Hardened Computer
flightComputers.explain: Industry-benchmark radiation-hardened 32-bit PowerPC architecture capable of surviving high-radiation Van Allen belt transits and deep-space missions.
flightComputers.basis: BAE Systems RAD750 Space Microprocessor Data Sheet, approximate, game-balanced

adcsSystems.name: Magnetic Torquers + Coarse Sun Sensors
adcsSystems.explain: Uses Earth's geomagnetic field to dump momentum and point solar arrays. Inexpensive and lightweight, but pointing is limited to ~1.0 degree.
adcsSystems.basis: NewSpace Systems Magnetorquer Rods & Sun Sensor Suite, approximate, game-balanced

adcsSystems.name: Reaction Wheels + Dual Star Trackers
adcsSystems.explain: High-agility 3-axis reaction wheel assembly paired with autonomous star pattern recognition for stable 0.01 degree pointing.
adcsSystems.basis: Blue Canyon Technologies RWP015 + NST-1 Star Tracker, approximate, game-balanced

adcsSystems.name: Ultra-Fine Pointing & Isolation Bench
adcsSystems.explain: Piezoelectric micro-vibration isolation platform paired with high-frequency gyro star trackers for sub-arcsecond pointing stability (0.001 deg).
adcsSystems.basis: Moog CSA Vibration Isolation System + Sodern Hydra Star Trackers, approximate, game-balanced

adcsSystems.name: High-Rate Cold Gas & Bipropellant RCS Quads
adcsSystems.explain: Fast-response reaction control system providing agile attitude maneuvering and rapid pitch/roll correction during powered descent.
adcsSystems.basis: Apollo LM RCS Quad Assembly / Aerojet Rocketdyne MR-103, approximate, game-balanced

thermals.name: Passive MLI Blankets & Surface Radiators
thermals.explain: Multilayer insulation blankets and optical solar reflectors that regulate internal temperatures through radiation balance without active moving parts.
thermals.basis: NASA Thermal Control Handbook, approximate, game-balanced

thermals.name: Active Ammonia Heat Pipes & Louvers
thermals.explain: Two-phase closed capillary fluid loops that transfer high waste heat loads from avionics and amplifiers to deployable radiators.
thermals.basis: Advanced Cooling Technologies Constant Conductance Heat Pipes, approximate, game-balanced

thermals.name: Active Stirling / Pulse Tube Cryocooler
thermals.explain: Closed-cycle cryogenic refrigeration engine capable of cooling infrared focal plane arrays to 65-80 Kelvin to suppress thermal dark noise.
thermals.basis: Northrop Grumman High-Efficiency Cryocooler (HEC), approximate, game-balanced

commsSystems.name: S-Band TT&C Transceiver
commsSystems.explain: Omnidirectional low-frequency radio link for health telemetry, spacecraft commanding, and low-rate emergency beacon communications.
commsSystems.basis: L3Harris S-Band Space Transponder, approximate, game-balanced

commsSystems.name: X-Band Science Downlink Transmitter
commsSystems.explain: Standard high-throughput space research downlink transmitter delivering up to 50 Mbps to terrestrial ground stations during line-of-sight passes.
commsSystems.basis: General Dynamics X-Band Mission Data Transmitter, approximate, game-balanced

commsSystems.name: Ka-Band High-Throughput System
commsSystems.explain: High-frequency wideband downlink achieving 150 Mbps for massive Earth observation imagery and synthetic aperture radar datasets.
commsSystems.basis: Thales Alenia Space Ka-Band Modulator/TWTA, approximate, game-balanced

commsSystems.name: Deep-Space High-Gain Antenna (HGA)
commsSystems.explain: Gimballed high-gain parabolic dish tuned for ultra-long-distance links with NASA's Deep Space Network from interplanetary ranges.
commsSystems.basis: JPL Mars Reconnaissance Orbiter 3.0m High-Gain Dish, approximate, game-balanced

commsSystems.name: Free-Space Optical Laser Comm Terminal
commsSystems.explain: Laser communication terminal delivering gigabit-class transmission with narrow beam divergence and low size and mass requirements.
commsSystems.basis: NASA LCRD / Psyche Deep Space Optical Communications (DSOC), approximate, game-balanced

storages.name: 128 GB Solid-State Recorder
storages.explain: Radiation-tolerant Flash memory buffer for storing science packets between ground station contact windows.
storages.basis: InnnoFlight Solid-State Flight Recorder, approximate, game-balanced

storages.name: 512 GB Solid-State Recorder
storages.explain: High-reliability mass memory unit supporting multiple passes of buffered high-resolution optical imagery.
storages.basis: Airbus Spacecraft Mass Memory Unit (MMU), approximate, game-balanced

storages.name: 2 TB Enterprise Space Data Recorder
storages.explain: High-throughput non-volatile storage capable of buffering multi-spectral scans and radar streams during communication outages.
storages.basis: SEAKR Engineering Mass Memory SSR, approximate, game-balanced
